beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until THE DEATH OF RECURRENCE unlocks 41.8 throughput?
beats.visual_focus: A glowing cluster of GPUs sits 95% frozen while a single sluggish sequential cursor crawls word-by-word.

visual_blueprint.title: THE SEQUENTIAL BOTTLENECK
visual_blueprint.sub: Massive parallel hardware starved by sequential dependencies

motif_params.title: THE SEQUENTIAL BOTTLENECK
motif_params.sub: Massive parallel hardware starved by sequential dependencies

beats.text: Recurrent networks chained your expensive GPUs to a sluggish bucket brigade. Token two waited on token one. Parallel hardware completely stalled.
beats.visual_focus: RNN hidden state vectors passing through an unrolled linear chain where downstream computation halts waiting on upstream steps.

visual_blueprint.title: RECURRENT DEPENDENCY CHAIN
visual_blueprint.sub: h_t = f(h_{t-1}, x_t) forces strictly sequential execution

motif_params.title: RECURRENT DEPENDENCY CHAIN
motif_params.sub: h_t = f(h_{t-1}, x_t) forces strictly sequential execution

beats.text: The Transformer completely shattered the chain. It discarded sequential loops and looked at every token simultaneously across the entire context window.
beats.visual_focus: The linear chain snaps apart into an all-to-all interconnected matrix graph refracting light across every token pair simultaneously.

visual_blueprint.title: THE DEATH OF RECUR ARCHITECTURE
visual_blueprint.sub: The linear chain snaps apart into an all-to-all interconnected ma

beats.text: Instead of passing hidden states. Queries multiply with keys to compute a dynamic attention matrix. Scaled dot-products route information instantly.
